suggest.ext-imagick: Preferred image driver for MediaService; GD is used as a fallback.
suggest.ext-exif: Corrects rotated JPEG photos when the GD driver is used.

scripts-descriptions.build: Compile SCSS and minify JS into public/ (production output).
scripts-descriptions.build:dev: Compile assets with expanded CSS and a source map.
scripts-descriptions.build:watch: Rebuild assets whenever a file under assets/ changes.
scripts-descriptions.analyse: Static analysis (PHPStan level 5). The memory limit is a flag because .neon cannot set it.
scripts-descriptions.fix: Apply the coding style (PSR-12, house-style braces - see .php-cs-fixer.dist.php).
scripts-descriptions.check: Everything CI would run, if there were CI: lint, analyse, test.
